messages:
lauren: Hey team, incoming support escalation from Acme — invoice INV-2026-0423 doesn't match the dashboard usage for March 24. Customer reports ~1.8k tokens on dashboard but invoice shows 2,130 tokens and a €0.02 VAT/rounding remainder. Can we triage? :thinking:
acme_support: Hi, thanks. Quick repro: we run inference batched, each request logs token_count. Summing tokens for 2026-03-24 from our API logs = 1,803 tokens. The CSV invoice lines show three merged rows, sums to 2,130. Attached sample lines below. We think per-line cent truncation during CSV aggregation is inflating the total.
acme_support: CSV lines:
```
2026-03-24,model-xyz,region-eu,requests,612,0.00045,0.2754
2026-03-24,model-xyz,region-eu,requests,591,0.00045,0.2660
2026-03-24,model-xyz,region-uk,requests,927,0.00045,0.41715
```
acme_support: If you compute price_per_unit*units then round each line to cents and sum, you get a different total than summing raw (units*price) then rounding at invoice level.
mike: Can you paste tenant_id + invoice PDF to the ticket? Need to pull raw meter_events. This looks like an aggregator bug when we split tax jurisdictions (EU vs UK) and do per-row currency truncation instead of invoice-level rounding.
lauren: tenant_id T-ACME-001, invoice INV-2026-0423. Uploaded PDF to the ticket.
raj: Known edge case — when we bucket by tax jurisdiction and round each bucket to 2 decimals we can introduce a remainder. Two things to check: (1) whether meter_events were deduped per-request; (2) whether CSV generator uses floor vs round. I can run a quick sum in the billing DB. Mike, Tom, any quick thoughts?
tom: I reproduced locally: aggregator groups by (date, model, tax_bucket) then does unit_price_cents = floor(unit_price * 100 * units) / 100 — so it's truncation. Minimal fix: switch to banker's rounding and deterministically distribute any leftover cents to the largest line items so invoice balances.
mike: SQL to pull raw usage (run in billing warehouse):
```
SELECT date, model, region, sum(tokens) as total_tokens, sum(cost) as raw_cost
FROM meter_events
WHERE tenant_id = 'T-ACME-001' AND date = '2026-03-24'
GROUP BY date, model, region;
```
mike: lauren can you run that and paste results. Also check billing/aggregator/config.yaml -> rounding: per_line vs per_invoice.
lauren: Ran the query — results pasted in ticket: 
```
2026-03-24 | model-xyz | region-eu | 1203 | 0.540
2026-03-24 | model-xyz | region-uk | 600  | 0.270
```
lauren: sum tokens 1803, raw_cost 0.810. Invoice shows 0.83 after per-line rounding + VAT split. So 0.02 delta.
sara: For customer-facing fix: we can issue a one-time credit for €0.02 and reissue invoice. Need accounting approval. Raj, ok to proceed?
raj: Approve credit under $25 threshold. Please include note 'rounding rebalancing' in ledger entry so audit trail is clear.
billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-0423 generated at 2026-03-25T02:13:47Z (automated).
mike: Engineering fix ETA — quick patch to change rounding mode in aggregator + distribute remainder will be in next small release (canary tomorrow). I'll add a migration to re-evaluate past invoices > $0.01 delta for affected tenants.
lauren: I'll send the credit and updated invoice, and follow up with customer tomorrow. Acme, thanks for clear repro steps — will keep you updated. :thumbsup:
acme_support: Thanks — appreciate fast turnaround.
tom: Followup note for engineers: add unit test that compares 'sum(round_per_line(cost))' vs 'round(sum(cost))' and asserts difference <= 0.01 for multi-tax scenarios. Also add test for banker's rounding behavior across currencies.
lauren: Closing triage for now, moving to billing backlog.
